info.title: Flow API
info.description: The browser API of Flow, phase 1. Single owner: every route but the auth ones requires the owner's session cookie. Errors carry a code (ErrorCode), never a sentence the UI shows. Session timelines are Flow events (contract/events.schema.json) delivered as server-sent events with the event's seq as the SSE id. Requests whose Origin or Referer is a preview host are refused with preview_origin. Route handlers are registered in backend/internal/httpapi/routes.go, one area interface per x-flow-area.

get.description: Server-sent events of kind flow (data: a Flow event). Durable events after the position (after, else Last-Event-ID, else 0) in seq order, then live; SSE id is seq, ephemeral events have no id. Starts with a live.snapshot when a block is open.
A page of durable events, backwards from before or forwards from after, for long histories.
